description: CPSS — Cyber-Physical Severity Scale: Dataset and Reference Implementation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Shusei Suzuki. CPSS (Cyber-Physical Severity Scale) is a logarithmic severity scale for evaluating the physical, environmental, and societal consequences of cyberattacks against Industrial Control Systems (ICS). CPSS bridges the gap between existing metrics: CVSS covers software vulnerability exploitability, HAZOP/SIL covers industrial process safety, and INES covers nuclear accidents only. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
